claims.text: The graph-based features include Coreness, Eccentricity, and Strength.
Coreness is computed for the Before and After graphs, while Eccentricity reflects changes in interactions around the targeted author.
Strength is also mentioned as a graph-based feature used in various fusion strategies.
Topological measures can handle/ignore edge weights and directions, and can be vertex- or graph-focused.
Different scales and scopes of topological measures are used, including microscopic, mesoscopic, and macroscopic measures.
